bounds.note: admission bounds which misses ENTER the cohort; observation bounds which cycles may RESOLVE them, and may extend later so a late-admitted miss still gets its catch-up window. Without --admission-end the cohort is NOT fixed and a rerun may report different counts.

eligibility_predicate: outcome IN ('success','relevant_miss') AND normal_feeds_complete=1 AND rss_requests>0 AND listing_requests>0
